## Summary
Groups Dependabot version updates by ecosystem to reduce notification and pull request volume:
- **`python-dependencies`**: Groups all Python dependency updates into a single PR, while excluding `google-adk` (which remains pinned exactly and will receive its own isolated PR for testing and verification).
- **`github-actions`**: Groups all GitHub Action workflow updates into a single PR.

## Verification
- Validated yaml structure against Dependabot v2 schema.
- Ran pre-commit lint and type gates (`./scripts/ruff-all.sh`).

patches..github/dependabot.yml:
@@ -9,8 +9,20 @@ updates:
     directory: "/"
     schedule:
       interval: "monthly"
+    groups:
+      python-dependencies:
+        patterns:
+          - "*"
+        exclude-patterns:
+          # Pinned exactly (==) as a verified baseline. Keep it in its own PR so it
+          # can be tested and reverted on its own.
+          - "google-adk"
 
   - package-ecosystem: "github-actions"
     directory: "/"
     schedule:
       interval: "monthly"
+    groups:
+      github-actions:
+        patterns:
+          - "*"
